recognize_zh: 箭頭所指為一群細胞中核質比高、染色質細緻並有一個明顯大核仁的母細胞；周圍布滿前骨髓球、骨髓球、後骨髓球、帶狀及分葉核中性球，並有血小板聚集，呈典型 CML 的連續成熟光譜，母細胞只是其中少數。
features: Arrowed blast: large cell with high N:C ratio, round nucleus, fine chromatin and a single prominent nucleolus
Blast cytoplasm scant to moderate, pale blue-grey, without visible Auer rods
Surrounding cells show a full spectrum of granulocytic maturation: promyelocytes, myelocytes, metamyelocytes, band and segmented neutrophils
Occasional cells with dark granules possibly representing basophils; platelet clumps present
Red cells normocytic without significant poikilocytosis; overall appearance of marked leukocytosis
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis with a full spectrum of granulocytic maturation, including promyelocytes, myelocytes, metamyelocytes, band and segmented neutrophils, with clusters of platelets. The arrowed cell is a blast with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, a prominent nucleolus and scant agranular cytoplasm, without Auer rods. Blasts appear infrequent relative to maturing forms in this field. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-positive; a manual differential with blast and basophil counts is needed to stage the disease.

ddx.vs: Reactive states show predominantly mature neutrophils with toxic changes and few myelocytes or blasts, lack basophilia, and are BCR::ABL1 negative.
aCML shows prominent dysgranulopoiesis and CMML shows monocytosis ≥10%, whereas CML has well-granulated cells with myelocyte and neutrophil peaks and basophilia.
Separated by counting blasts (≥20% for blast phase, or an increasing proportion) and basophils rather than by the morphology of a single blast.
CNL shows ≥80% segmented/band neutrophils with <10% immature granulocytes and CSF3R mutation, lacking the myelocyte bulge seen here.
